content.text: The text combines several unrelated excerpts: a medical index covering scrofula, scurvy, stomach diseases, stomatitis, syphilis, and many treatments; comic scenes in which Maggie enters Zoie’s bedroom, Alfred goes into the adjoining room, Aggie enters the bathroom area to free him, Jimmy hides beneath the bedclothes, and officers bring the babies into the room before exposing Zoie’s deception; natural-history articles on raccoons, birds, butterflies, foxes, squirrels, sandpipers, eyes, and zoological preserves; agricultural and industrial essays on marble, farms, lime kilns, apple-jelly manufacture, grape bags, solar heat, and American woods; a guide to determining the true meridian; and religious and literary discussions of Unction, Penance, Sterne, and his influence in Germany.
